title: Design System: Yogita Yadav — Specimen Nº 04

display.purpose: Hero statements only; italic phrase takes the accent color.

headline.purpose: Section titles; second line is the italic accent phrase.

label.purpose: Mono uppercase micro-labels: section labels, chips, button captions.

figure.purpose: Mono figures: FIG. numbers, metric rows, captions, tooltips.

shadows.name: nav-frame
shadows.purpose: The only elevation in the system: the floating navigator glass frame. Never applied to plates.

motion.name: theme-flip
motion.purpose: Day/night theme transition on .scope and body.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Hover/color transitions on buttons, bubbles, links.

motion.name: glare-sweep
motion.purpose: One-shot glare across hovered pills; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single accent CTA — contact-scale pill (used for the email action on FIG. 10).
components.html: yogitayadav422003@gmail.com
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font: 500 1rem 'Switzer', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Default secondary action — hairline pill that tints with ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 12.5px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 500 0.9rem 'Switzer', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Solid Button
components.description: Emphatic ink-filled pill — used for navigation's primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-solid { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 12.5px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font: 500 0.9rem 'Switzer', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-solid:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 86%, var(--paper)); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 86%, var(--paper)); }

components.name: Mono Label
components.description: The lab hand: uppercase mono micro-label used for section labels, metadata rows and tooltips.
components.css: .ds-label { font: 500 10.5px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3); }

components.name: Email Copy Pill
components.description: Signature contact component — accent pill split by a hairline: mailto segment + mono COPY segment with copied state.
components.html: yogitayadav422003@gmail.com
components.css: .ds-copy-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: stretch; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); overflow: hidden; } .ds-copy-pill__mail { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; padding: 16px 20px 16px 28px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font: 500 15px 'Switzer', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-copy-pill__divider { width: 1px; margin: 14px 0; background: currentColor; opacity: 0.25; } .ds-copy-pill__copy { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 16px 24px 16px 16px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; font: 500 10.5px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.14em; } .ds-copy-pill:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigator Glass Frame
components.description: The only elevated surface in the system: floating glass nav with pill items; active item is an accent pill.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 72%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18); } .ds-nav__item { padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 10.5px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav__item--active { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); } .ds-nav__item:not(.ds-nav__item--active):hover { color: var(--ink); }

narrative.overview: The site is a field journal that happens to be a portfolio: sections are catalogue plates, every project carries a FIG. number, and annotations sit in the margins in mono type. The system reads as printed evidence — warm paper, iron-gall ink, one laboratory accent — not as a screen product. Density is deliberate and uneven: generous editorial air around display type, tight analytical rows inside data plates. The component feel is a measured instrument: hairline rules instead of shadows, pill actions instead of rounded cards, mono micro-labels instead of icon noise. Two scoped themes are first-class citizens — day is Archival Paper, night is Graphite — and every plate must read correctly in both, including inverted sections that intentionally flip the paper.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper base with iron-gall text; one cobalt accent per plate.
Hairline (1px) rules and grid textures carry all structure; shadows are absent.
Gambetta italic accents paired with JetBrains Mono annotations; Switzer carries body.
Sections open with a mono label row (label left, FIG. number right) under a hairline.
Interactive accents are canvas/WebGL artefacts that follow theme tokens live.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Laboratory Cobalt / Lavender Blueprint is the only chromatic accent; it appears on ≤10% of any plate. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Two Papers Rule
rules.body: Every component ships with both theme scopes (.t-day / .t-night). A component that only reads on one paper is unfinished.

rules.name: The Marginalia Rule
rules.body: Mono is the lab hand: annotations, numbers, microcopy. Body copy is never mono, display type never mono.

rules.name: The Italic Accent Rule
rules.body: Display and headline italics take the accent color; roman text never does.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat plates. If something needs emphasis, add a hairline or change the paper tone — never a drop shadow.

dos: Do keep structure on 1px hairlines and paper tone changes (--line, --paper-2).
Do use the mono label row (label left / FIG. number right) to open every section.
Do drive every color from the theme tokens so both scopes stay correct; accents re-read tokens live (canvas MutationObserver pattern).
Do guard every animation with prefers-reduced-motion and pause off-screen loops via IntersectionObserver.
Do pair every claim with a figure, metric, or FIG. number — evidence over adjectives.
donts: Don't introduce drop shadows on plates (the navigator's glass frame is the only exception).
Don't add a second chromatic accent; Specimen Red stays reserved for signal duty.
Don't set body or display copy in mono, or use italics without the accent/roman split.
Don't fabricate evidence — no testimonials, client logos, or press that do not exist.
Don't break the prerender: every build must emit rendered HTML (scripts/prerender.mjs), never an empty SPA shell.
